title: Vercel UI SDK: Git-Diff Framework Expert Routing (expert-scope.mjs) & Multi-Skill Agent Hygiene
summary: Multi-framework monorepo governance routes git diffs automatically to framework experts (react, vue, svelte, solid, web) via scripts/expert-scope.mjs: package-specific files route only to their owning framework expert, while shared packages/core/, tests/specs/, and tests/fixtures.ts fan out to all five experts from per-expert Last reviewed commits, enforced alongside AGENTS.md rules on zero runtime deps, comment brevity, and ui-sdk-write-code -> ui-sdk-unslop -> ui-sdk-expert-review workflows.

references.description: owns(framework, file), shared(file) fan-out rules, and per-expert Last reviewed base commit resolution
Monorepo coding rules: zero runtime deps, comment length cap, internal .agents/skills vs shipped packages/core/skills/ui-sdk

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Multi-framework UI monorepos scale review hygiene by routing shared core/spec diffs to every adapter expert while isolating framework-owned changes and separating internal authoring skills from shipped user skills.
